en.p: A quartic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient 1 and a function $g(x)$ with $g(x)\ge 0$ on the interval $(0,\,\infty)$ satisfy the following conditions.
When $\displaystyle\int_{4}^{5}g(x)\,dx=\frac{q}{p}$, find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
